description: Search RateMDs doctors and practices, or fetch known profiles, with optional patient reviews.

acceptingNewPatients.description: Only return doctors currently accepting new patients.
acceptingNewPatients.title: Accepting new patients

acceptingVirtualVisits.description: Only return doctors offering virtual/telehealth appointments.
acceptingVirtualVisits.title: Accepting virtual visits

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. 'New York' or 'new-york') used with search, bySpecialty and practiceSearch.
city.title: City

country.description: Country filter for doctor or practice searches.
country.title: Country

doctorSlug.description: A doctor's RateMDs slug or full profile URL (mode=doctorProfile). Current and legacy URL formats are accepted.
doctorSlug.title: Doctor slug or URL

gender.description: Filter doctors by gender when RateMDs publishes it.
gender.title: Doctor gender

includePartnerReviews.description: Also fetch RateMDs 'Our Partners' reviews for doctor profiles (one extra request per review page).
includePartnerReviews.title: Include partner reviews

includePracticeDetails.description: For practiceSearch, fetch each clinic page for address, phone, website, rating and doctors. Adds one request per practice.
includePracticeDetails.title: Enrich practices with details

includeReviews.description: Fetch patient reviews. For doctor search this adds one profile request per doctor; for profile modes it fetches more review pages; for practice modes it includes embedded practice reviews.
includeReviews.title: Include recent reviews

location.description: Legacy free-text location, e.g. 'New York' or 'Toronto, ON'. Used with search and bySpecialty. Structured City/State below take precedence.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to walk per run.
maxPages.title: Max listing pages

maxReviewPages.description: Number of review pages to fetch per doctor when reviews are enabled (10 reviews per page).
maxReviewPages.title: Max review pages per doctor

enumTitles: Search doctors by name, keyword or condition
Fetch a list of doctor profile URLs
Fetch one or more practice profile URLs
mode.title: Mode

onlineScheduling.description: Only return doctors with online appointment booking enabled.
onlineScheduling.title: Online scheduling

openNow.description: Only return practices that are open at the time of the run.
openNow.title: Open now

practiceUrls.description: List of RateMDs clinic URLs or slugs to fetch, e.g. 'https://www.ratemds.com/clinic/us-sc-north-charleston-total-family-wellness/'.
practiceUrls.title: Practice profile URLs (mode=practiceProfile)

profileUrls.description: List of RateMDs doctor profile URLs or slugs to fetch.
profileUrls.title: Doctor profile URLs (mode=byUrl)

searchQuery.description: Doctor name, specialty keyword or medical condition (mode=search). Example: 'cardiologist' or 'Dr. Jane Doe'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

specialty.description: Medical specialty to browse (mode=bySpecialty) or to narrow a keyword search.
enumTitles: Ear, Nose, and Throat Doctor / Otolaryngologist (ENT)
specialty.title: Specialty

state.description: Two-letter state/province code (e.g. 'ny', 'ca', 'on') used with search, bySpecialty and practiceSearch.
state.title: State / province

verified.description: Only return doctors marked as verified by RateMDs.
verified.title: Verified profiles only

title: RateMDs Doctor & Practice Scraper Input
